CLMA No.12431 of 2019 (Delay Condonation Appl. in Time Barred CLR)
In 
CRLR No.109 of 2019
Hon’ble N.S. Dhanik, J.
Mr. Shiv Pandey, learned counsel for the 
revisionist.
Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, learned counsel for the 
respondent.
There is a delay of 85 days in filing the 
present criminal revision. Accordingly, delay 
condonation application has been moved by the 
revisionist, which is supported by an affidavit.
Since the delay condonation application is not 
opposed by learned counsel for the respondent,
hence, the delay condonation application (CLMA 
No.12431 of 2019) is allowed.
Heard.
Admit.
Summon the LCR.
List after LCR is received.
 
 (N.S. Dhanik, J.) 
21.12.2020 BS/SS
